summary: Allarity Therapeutics filed an 8-K on September 16, 2026 reporting that the Japan Patent Office granted Japanese Patent No. 7917283 covering its stenoparib-specific Drug Response Predictor companion diagnostic, with protection extending into 2039. The announcement, dated September 15, 2026, came via a press release attached as Exhibit 99.1. CEO Thomas Jensen framed the grant as strengthening intellectual property for stenoparib across major commercial markets. No financial terms, ownership changes, or corporate transactions were disclosed. The filing is a routine current report on an ordinary intellectual property development, not a special situation.
